build_role: contract only - no runtime code, settings or state

authority.transport: PAPER HMAC API only (same as /api/capital/ack); no CLI in v1
authority.github_calls: never - runtime records the numeric comment id only
authority.evidence: acceptance/activation evidence resolves the id to a signed Codex comment naming the exact row

input.net_field: absent - no P&L is supplied or invented

admission: bad row_id / blank reason / comment_id not matching pattern -> refused
index missing or not a dict -> refused (guard stays fail-closed)
row_id not in index and not in ack record -> refused: unknown
row_id still in history -> refused: not evicted
malformed entry (non-dict or unknown sleeve) -> allowed; raw entry NOT stored (OQ5)
same path for every slot in CANDIDATE_SLOTS (OQ8)

steps: write ack record (whitelisted scalar entry + entry_sha256)
save_state(); on failure roll back both changes, delete a newly created empty ack dict, refuse (fail closed)
effect.failed_save_side_effects: _save_safe -> _persist_fault latches state_untrusted and sets ENTRIES_PAUSED; a held file also returns False with entries paused; the ack path must not suppress it
effect.concurrency: A4 runs under self.lock; the guard read (_candidate_pending_why) sees before or after, never entry popped with record missing

idempotent.repeat_same_row: ok, 'already acknowledged', no write, no save, first record kept

never: re-enable a slot or touch candidate_disabled
write exchange order / trade / client order ids
change any P&L, R, px_ack, pnl_fill_adj, cost_rev, ML label, audit, cohort or evidence figure
clear by time, restart or any automatic path
clear an entry whose row is still in history
persist raw unexpected keys or identifier-bearing content from a malformed entry
write or mutate cohort (RUN-PACK) evidence or the evidence store
suppress the AUD-05 pause caused by a failed save
call GitHub or any network client

canary.question: OQ1
canary.rule: an acked evicted C-F01 close after the frozen start counts toward the 8-close bound, stays unmeasured and blocks new C-F01 risk; only a later Integration-frozen start after that close excludes it; never assume 0 R
canary.block_text: F01 canary: <n> evicted C-F01 close(s) acknowledged without a measured net - drawdown not measurable, no new C-F01 entry (fail closed)

ordering: implementation after PR #249 merge; T14 gated on f01_canary on master

record.entry_value_types: str (<=64 chars), finite int/float, None; anything else -> None
record.entry_sha256: sha256 of json.dumps(original, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=repr)
record.retention: unbounded durable state audit, no cap or eviction (OQ6)

required_test_notes.T3: byte-identical state; no empty candidate_cost_pending_ack left behind
required_test_notes.T7: save failure: rollback incl. new empty ack dict; state_untrusted latched and ENTRIES_PAUSED True on the write-exception path
required_test_notes.T11: malformed entry: whitelisted scalars + entry_sha256 only
required_test_notes.T17: guard/ack interleaving: no half-state (entry popped, record missing)
required_test_notes.T18: no cohort/evidence write, no GitHub/network call
required_test_notes.T19: C-F02 entry acked by the same path

resolved_questions.OQ1: A7 accepted: counts toward 8-close bound, unmeasured, blocks new C-F01 risk; later frozen start excludes; never 0 R
resolved_questions.OQ2: PAPER HMAC API only; no CLI in v1
resolved_questions.OQ3: record numeric comment id, never call GitHub; evidence resolves it to a signed Codex comment naming the row
resolved_questions.OQ5: ackable, not verbatim: whitelisted scalar sleeve/symbol/closed + sha256 of canonical original
resolved_questions.OQ6: durable unbounded state audit in v1; no cap or eviction
resolved_questions.OQ7: state record + WARNING log only; never write or mutate cohort evidence
resolved_questions.OQ8: same path for all CANDIDATE_SLOTS; A7 scoring is C-F01 only
